_note: mm. body/pcb/a010/battery/xt60: torso (trunk_base) frame, +x forward, +y left, +z up, standing pose. head: lower-head mesh frame (x width, -y front, z up).

pcb_stack.note: UNO Q + resized HAT, 70 tall x 53.34 across, 16 mm stack; behind the leg sweep (check_pcb_target.py target region)

battery.note: 2S LiPo ~800-1000 mAh, 60 x 28 x 15 mm, XT60 lead (XT30 also fits)

xt60.note: XT60 pair below the pack; unplug through the keel's bottom opening

mouth_servo.note: XL330-size (34 x 20 x 26) lying sideways above the lower-shell pedestal, under the forehead; drives the jaw through a short link

head._note: cx/widen/rear_*/upper_zshift: record of the one-off deformation that made head_upper_v4.stl and head_lower_v4_whole.stl from the V3 head (deleted); jaw and mouth_servo are rebuilt by build_v4.py

envelopes.name: usb_c_top
envelopes.note: UNO Q USB-C, straight plug: UNO form factor has the USB on a short edge, which is the top (or bottom) edge of the upright stack. 12.4 x 6.5 mm overmold, 25 mm with strain relief and cable bend. ESTIMATE

envelopes.name: usb_c_rear
envelopes.note: the same plug if the receptacle faced rearwards through usb_access (what the cut assumes). ESTIMATE

envelopes.name: xt60_mating_plug
envelopes.note: female XT60 (8.2 x 15.8 mm, 16 mm long) pushed onto the pack's male from below, plus a 10 mm bend of its 14 AWG lead. ESTIMATE

envelopes.name: balance_plug
envelopes.note: 2S JST-XH balance plug (12 x 5.8 x 12 mm incl. leads) stowed beside the XT60 below the pack; it leaves the same end as the power leads. ESTIMATE

envelopes.name: a010_usb
envelopes.note: A010 USB-C cable, straight plug at the sensor's rear face (25 mm with strain relief). ESTIMATE

envelopes.name: mouth_servo_cable
envelopes.note: XL330 JST-EH plug (8 mm) and 4 mm cable bend at the mouth servo's +x end, lower-head mesh frame. ESTIMATE

print._note: print settings behind the provisional printed-part masses (scripts/make_duck.py wall-proxy formula): wall_mm = perimeter thickness per surface, infill = fraction of the remaining volume. A per-part entry (head_upper_v4, head_lower_v4, jaw_v4, body_shell_v4) overrides default. Head reduction options: design/v4/README.md

_proposed_head._note: head mass reduction, not applied (design/v4/head_mass.py, README): move these into the per-part keys to use them. 0.8 mm = 2 perimeters of a 0.4 mm nozzle. Check stiffness of the dome and the jaw hinge on a printed part first.
